grok @bot combined with cloud agents is a magical experience! here's my favorite use case:

1. create a new team engineer bot and add it to slack 
2. @ your bot whenever you want it to do some coding work 
3. you can even tell it to create new Projects, which is a way to group together many related agents into one conversation

you can use any model available on cursor with these cloud agents, and since they each have their own computer, it frees up your bot to be more of a manager rather than write the code itself!

TRXS 打通美国主流券商渠道 ：顶级平台中已有七家支持交易

美国拥有庞大而成熟的证券经纪体系。根据 FINRA 公布的数据显示，全美注册券商超过 3000 家，真正面向散户、又有公开客户资产可对比的主流网上券商并不多。其中 9 家里已有 7 家支持 TRXS。

目前可交易 TRXS 的券商平台为 ：

Fidelity 、Charles Schwab、Vanguard、E*TRADE、Interactive Brokers、Robinhood、Webull、SoFi Invest、Public 

三大券商巨头，全部支持 TRXS

Fidelity、Charles Schwab 和 Vanguard 通常被视为美国个人投资与资产管理领域的三大巨头。这三家平台均可交易 TRXS，所代表的不只是券商数量的增加，更是 TRXS 市场覆盖能力的一次重要突破。

超50万亿美元的平台资产，TRXS 拥有一席之地

如果按照最新公开数据及图中可比口径估算，仅 Fidelity、Charles Schwab、Vanguard 和 E-TRADE 母公司 Morgan Stanley 四个平台背后的客户资产合计约 53–56 万亿美元。

虽然这并不意味着这些资金会直接流入TRXS
但它说明了一件事 ：
TRXS已经出现在全球最大资金平台的交易系统中。

渠道决定入口，入口连接资金

一项资产要进入主流市场，先要解决“在哪里可以买”。也就是说传统市场的投资者现在不必离开熟悉的证券账户，就能获得 TRX 相关敞口。渠道已经铺开，接下来就是沉淀了。新产品上线后，资金通常会先观望，后面就交给市场来验证。

是金子，总会发光。

someone's been extracting the hidden instructions every AI chatbot gets before your first message, and putting them on Github.

68,700 stars. Fable 5.1, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, Grok 4.7, GPT-6 Luna. captured word for word, updated constantly.

read a few and you'll see how the people who build these models actually write instructions. where they're specific, where they repeat themselves, what they ban outright, how they handle a refusal.
